metadata.description: Deal Desk plugins for real estate agents: Deadline Tracker and TC.

plugins.name: deal-desk-deadline-tracker
plugins.description: Reads contract papers, builds a deadline table with sources, proposes calendar events, and shows amendment changes before any date moves. Never sends, signs, or invites; every write waits for your yes.

plugins.name: deal-desk-tc
plugins.description: Transaction coordination in your own Transact: opens files, fills and checks forms, preps signing drafts, and files compliance. Never sends, signs, or submits without your yes.
